capabilities: commit, pull, push and sync the vault with a Git remote
show modified files, branch state and unpushed/unpulled commits in a sidebar panel and status bar
initialize a repository with an Obsidian .gitignore and .gitattributes
warn before committing large files and work with Git LFS
report merge conflicts and abort or conclude the merge
extras: Desktop-only (Windows, macOS, Linux); before listing in the community directory it can be installed via BRAT or manually. Notes a Flatpak limitation where the sandbox cannot see the system Git, and documents its privacy behavior (no network requests of its own, no telemetry).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Git support, so keeping a vault versioned and backed up to a Git remote normally means running terminal commands and handling credentials yourself.

relations.evidence: keeps your vault under Git, built on simple-git

summary: Git-based vault sync that commits, pulls, pushes and syncs from Obsidian's UI without terminal use or credential prompts.
